Our operational models are built on free, reproducible, open-access workflows.

::: {.project-card}
### 🌍 Automated Coastal Ecosystem Monitoring Tool
A cloud-based pipeline leveraging public satellite archives and Google Earth Engine to track regional land-cover dynamics and coastal changes across the Caribbean.
[\*]{.underline} \*\*Core Stack:\*\* Python, Google Earth Engine API, JavaScript
:::

::: {.project-card}
### 🦎 Habitat Suitability Analytics Engine
An open-source modeling suite built to clean raw animal sighting metrics and calculate complex landscape fragmentation values.
[\*]{.underline} \*\*Core Stack:\*\* R (\`sf\`, \`terra\`), Git-backed version management
:::
